title: A separation criterion for low-degree coefficients
statement: Let $n,\ell,m$ be natural numbers, and choose $m$ inputs from the Boolean cube $\mathbb F_2^n$. Evaluation on these inputs is injective on the coefficient arrays indexed by subsets of $[n]$ of size at most $\ell$ if and only if every nonzero such coefficient array has a nonzero polynomial evaluation at at least one of the chosen inputs, where the polynomial is the sum of its coefficients times the corresponding square-free monomials over $\mathbb F_2$.
hypotheses_covered: A list of $m$ inputs in $\mathbb F_2^n$ is fixed
